notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. The register entry is the only source for the 1922 build, the 1987 removal and the 2008 registration; the Forest Lookouts page for Goodwin Knob has only a county header, so it is not cited. Staffing, design, agency and access are left out because no source gives them. 'Built on a building' is the register's wording; no source read says what the building was. PeakVisor gives the height of the knob, not of the tower, and the story says so. The brief's elevation_m is absent from the record and no value is proposed. A Mindat page for the knob was blocked (HTTP 403) and is not used. Used about 7 page reads and 2 searches, slightly over the per-tower read budget, to test for a second source that did not turn up.
